exception_description: Applicant claims acquisition at birth abroad but form routed through derivation workflow; different evidence standards.

exception_title: Parent's Naturalization Date vs Child's Birth Date
exception_description: Parent naturalized after child turned 18; derivation clock not stopped at majority; certificate issued incorrectly.

exception_title: Physical Presence of USC Parent Calculation
exception_description: INA §301(g) physical-presence transmission requirement: 5-year calculation for parent born after 1952 uses wrong threshold.

exception_title: Adoptive vs Biological Parent Citizenship Path
exception_description: Child adopted abroad; INA §320 automatic acquisition requires legal adoption finalized before age 16; age-check skipped.
Parent relinquished citizenship before child's birth; system still applies §301 transmission without checking parent's renunciation date.
Certified translation of foreign birth certificate contains OCR-introduced errors in father's name; parentage check fails.

exception_title: Parent's Certificate of Naturalization vs USCIS Record
exception_description: Certificate number on parent's N-550 does not match USCIS naturalization database record; derivation chain breaks.
LLM routes child residing abroad to §320 (automatic) when §322 (applied-for, residing abroad) is the correct path.

exception_title: Duplicate N-600 for Same Citizen Child
exception_description: Two N-600 applications filed by each parent independently for same child; both proceed to certificate production.
Child turns 18 during N-600 adjudication; §320 automatic citizenship already attached but interview not completed.
Statutory amendment (e.g., CCA 2000) extends citizenship retroactively; system applies current law to historical derivation date.
Foreign-born USC parent's criminal history abroad not checked through INTERPOL channel before certificate issued.
LLM misapplies INA §309 paternity legitimation requirements for child born out of wedlock to USC father.
N-600K (abroad) and N-600 (domestic) filed simultaneously; parallel adjudication creates two certificate records.

exception_title: Certificate Not Linked to Naturalization Record
exception_description: N-600 certificate issued but not linked to underlying parent's naturalization record; derivation chain cannot be audited.
